description: A gene/drug-target dossier fanned out to five independent sources in one call: Open Targets (function, tractability, top associated diseases), an NCBI/UniProt plain-English function summary, ChEMBL (known drugs and their mechanism/clinical phase, cross-referenced with indications), ClinicalTrials.gov (trials by gene/condition term), and Europe PMC (top cited papers). Each source fails independently — a down source returns null/empty for its own section rather than failing the whole call, and every failure is listed in "sourceErrors" rather than silently omitted.

gene.description: A human gene symbol ("TP53") or Ensembl gene ID ("ENSG00000141510").

name: gene_dossier
title: Gene/Target Dossier
